viewer: Investors in the 24% tax bracket holding a $50,000 index fund position with a $10,000 gain, bought 11 months ago.
decision: Sell now at the short-term tax rate, or wait a month for the lower long-term rate?
promise: We replay every month-long stretch of recent market history to see how often waiting for the lower rate left investors with less after tax.
title: Sell at 11 Months or Wait for the Lower Tax Rate?
thumbnail: a desk calendar with its last page curling over a stock chart / "Wait or Sell?"
